§aTime for some real armor.§f

Steel Armor gives you 7.5 defense with 0.05 RR and a 0.9 damage modifier. Standard issue, nothing fancy, but it'll keep you alive long enough to get better stuff. Craft it from steel ingots.

Titanium Armor bumps defense to 10 with a 0.85 damage modifier. Same RR, better damage reduction across the board. You'll need the Blast Furnace for titanium.

Also in this tier: Casual Armor (cloth, barely counts), Security Armor (Kevlar, Steel, and Bakelite), and Fire Proximity Armor for heat work around furnaces.

§ePS:§f Steel armor is good enough until you reach Cobalt. Don't over-invest in titanium unless you really need the extra defense.
